description: This source file defines a WebhookDispatcher service for handling webhook notifications related to execution events. It includes implementation details for starting/stopping the dispatcher, scheduling webhook deliveries, processing HTTP requests, and updating webhook states based on delivery results.

classes.name: webhookDispatcher
classes.description: Implements the WebhookDispatcher interface, managing the lifecycle, scheduling, and execution of webhook notifications with concurrency control and retry mechanisms.

classes.name: webhookJob
classes.description: Represents a job for a specific execution webhook dispatch, identified by its execution ID.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the webhook dispatcher, launching worker and poller goroutines, and resuming pending deliveries.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the dispatcher, waiting for ongoing processes to complete.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Schedules a webhook for delivery for a specific execution ID.

methods.name: scanDue
methods.description: Identifies webhooks that are due for delivery and schedules them.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Worker goroutine that processes webhook jobs from the queue.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the actual sending of webhook HTTP requests and updates webhook states based on responses.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs the payload for webhook notification based on execution data.

methods.name: resolveTargetType
methods.description: Determines whether the target is a 'reasoner' or 'skill' based on the execution's node and reasoner IDs.

methods.name: computeBackoff
methods.description: Calculates exponential backoff duration based on the attempt count.

methods.name: determineWebhookEvent
methods.description: Maps execution status to webhook event types.

methods.name: decodeExecutionPayload
methods.description: Attempts to decode the execution's result payload into a Go data structure.

methods.name: generateWebhookSignature
methods.description: Creates an HMAC SHA256 signature for webhook payload verification.
